title: Globbing Basics
description:
Globbing is how the shell matches filenames using patterns instead of typing everything manually.

The most common patterns are:
- `*` matches anything (any number of characters)
- `?` matches exactly one character
- `[]` matches a set of characters

Examples:
- `ls *.txt` matches all .txt files
- `ls file?.txt` matches file1.txt, fileA.txt, etc
- `ls file[1-3].txt` matches file1.txt, file2.txt, file3.txt
